findings.claim: The reworded header says getconf ARG_MAX is 'a quarter of the stack limit, kept between 128 KiB and 6 MiB' on glibc. The 6 MiB ceiling is the kernel's execve cap (3/4 of the 8 MiB _STK_LIM). As I recall glibc's sysconf, it returns rlim_cur/4 with a 128 KiB floor and no upper cap. If so, a stack limit above 24 MiB would make getconf report more than 6 MiB, and the new text would be wrong about what getconf prints. The edit exists to say only what was measured, and the added test pins the string 'between 128 KiB and 6 MiB'.
